Operations.Name: DiskDetails
Operations.Description: Return detailed information for all disks on the system.

Arguments.Name: data
Arguments.Description: Disk query parameters specifying which disks to return and options.

Operations.Name: DiskGetInstance
Operations.Description:
Returns instance matching `id`. If `id` is not found, Validation error is raised.

Please see `query` method documentation for `options`.

Arguments.Name: options
Arguments.Description: Query options customize the results returned by a query method. More complete documentation with examples     are covered in the "Query methods" section of the TrueNAS API documentation.

Operations.Name: DiskGetUsed
Operations.Description:
Return disks that are in use by any zpool that is currently imported. It will
also return disks that are in use by any zpool that is exported.

`join_partitions`: Bool, when True will return all partitions currently written to disk
    NOTE: this is an expensive operation

Arguments.Name: join_partitions
Arguments.Description:
Return all partitions currently written to disk.

**NOTE: this is an expensive operation.**

Operations.Name: DiskQuery
Operations.Description:
Query disks.

The following extra options are supported:

`include_expired` (bool): Also include expired disks (default: false).
`passwords` (bool): Don't hide KMIP password for the disks (default: false).
`pools` (bool): Join pool name for each disk (default: false).

Arguments.Name: filters
Arguments.Description: List of filters for query results. See API documentation for "Query Methods" for more guidance.

Arguments.Name: options
Arguments.Description: Query options including pagination, ordering, and additional parameters.

Operations.Name: DiskTemperatureAgg
Operations.Description: Returns min/max/avg temperature for `names` disks for the last `days` days

Arguments.Name: names
Arguments.Description: Array of disk names to retrieve temperature aggregates for.

Arguments.Name: days
Arguments.Description: Number of days to aggregate temperature data over.

Operations.Name: DiskTemperatureAlerts
Operations.Description: Returns existing temperature alerts for specified disks.

Arguments.Name: names
Arguments.Description: Array of disk names to check for temperature-related alerts.

Operations.Name: DiskTemperatures
Operations.Description:
Returns disk temperatures for disks in degrees celsius.

NOTE:
    Disk temperatures are not retrieved more than
    once every 5 minutes.

Arguments.Name: name
Arguments.Description: List of names of disks to retrieve temperature information. Name should be in the form of "sda", "nvme0n1", etc.

Arguments.Name: include_thresholds
Arguments.Description: Include the temperature thresholds as reported by the disk (i.e. the critical temp).

Operations.Name: DiskWipe
Operations.Description: Performs a wipe of a disk `dev`.

Arguments.Name: dev
Arguments.Description: The device to perform the disk wipe operation on. May be passed as /dev/sda or just sda.

Arguments.Name: mode
Arguments.Description:
* QUICK: Write zeros to the first and last 32MB of device.
* FULL: Write whole disk with zeros.
* FULL_RANDOM: Write whole disk with random bytes.

Arguments.Name: synccache
Arguments.Description: Synchronize the device with the database.

Models.Name: DiskDetailsData
Models.Description: Disk query parameters specifying which disks to return and options.

Fields.Name: JoinPartitions
Fields.Description:
Return all partitions currently written to disk.

**NOTE: This is an expensive operation.**

Fields.Name: Type
Fields.Description:
* `USED`: Only disks that are IN USE will be returned.
* `UNUSED`: Only disks that are NOT IN USE are returned.
* `BOTH`: Used and unused disks will be returned.

Models.Name: DiskGetInstanceOptions
Models.Description: Query options customize the results returned by a query method. More complete documentation with examples     are covered in the "Query methods" section of the TrueNAS API documentation.

Fields.Name: Extra
Fields.Description: Extra options are defined on a per-endpoint basis and are described in the documentation for the associated     query method.

Fields.Name: ForceSqlFilters
Fields.Description: Force use of SQL for result filtering to reduce response time. May not work for all methods.

Fields.Name: Limit
Fields.Description:
This specifies the maximum number of results matching the specified `query-filters` to return. When     combined wtih the `offset` query-option it may be used to implement pagination of large results arrays.

WARNING: Some query methods provide volatile results and the onus is on the developer to understand whether     pagination is appropriate for a particular query API method.

Fields.Name: Offset
Fields.Description: This specifies the beginning offset of the results array. When combined with the `limit` query-option     it may be used to implement pagination of large results arrays. WARNING: some query methods provide     volatile results and the onus is on the developer to understand whether pagination is appropriate     for a particular query API method.

Fields.Name: OrderBy
Fields.Description: An array of field names describing the manner in which query results should be ordered. The field names may     also have one of more of the following special prefixes: `-` (reverse sort direction), `nulls_first:` (place     any null values at the head of the results list), `nulls_last:` (place any null values at the tail of the     results list).

Fields.Name: Select
Fields.Description: An array of field names specifying the exact fields to include in the query return. The dot character `.`     may be used to explicitly select only subkeys of the query result.

Fields.Name: Avg
Fields.Description: Average temperature during the time period or `null`.

Fields.Name: Max
Fields.Description: Maximum temperature recorded during the time period or `null`.

Fields.Name: Min
Fields.Description: Minimum temperature recorded during the time period or `null`.

Fields.Name: Advpowermgmt
Fields.Description: Advanced power management level or `DISABLED` to turn off power management.

Fields.Name: Bus
Fields.Description: System bus type the disk is connected to.

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Human-readable description of the disk device.

Fields.Name: Enclosure
Fields.Description: Physical enclosure information or `null` if not in an enclosure.

Fields.Name: Hddstandby
Fields.Description: Hard disk standby timer in minutes or `ALWAYS ON` to disable standby.

Fields.Name: Lunid
Fields.Description: Logical unit number identifier or `null` if not applicable.

Fields.Name: Number
Fields.Description: Numeric identifier assigned to the disk.

Fields.Name: Passwd
Fields.Description: Disk encryption password (masked for security).

Fields.Name: Pool
Fields.Description: Name of the storage pool this disk belongs to. `null` if not part of any pool.
